Salary: c.£120,000
Location: Kings X, London; Tues - Thurs (3 days) at HQ, Monday + Friday, anywhere
Employment Type: Full-time; we are open to discussing this opportunity as a part-time role (80%) or fractional commitment (25–50%) depending on mutual fit
Contract: Two-year fixed term, with the possibility of extension
Start Date: Immediate



About ARIA

ARIA empowers scientists to pursue breakthroughs at the edge of the possible.

From climate change to AI, society faces enormous challenges and opportunities that can be uniquely addressed through science and technology. ARIA was created to activate the UK’s world-class R&D in new ways, so we can meet these head on.

Our success is shaped by one question: how will ARIA transform the lives of the UK’s future generations? Whether that is a life-changing new technology or a burgeoning new industry, it should be obvious that ARIA played a catalytic role.

If you want to help make breakthroughs like these possible, come and build ARIA with us.
data.key_responsibilities:
• Take overall responsibility for the successful management and delivery of the Scaling Inference Lab, working closely with ARIA teams, project leads and delivery partners.
  • Set and drive the programme’s path to scale, including its operating model, long-term funding approach and governance arrangements.
  • Represent ARIA in the relevant CommonAI governance structures and external partnerships as ARIA’s senior representative for the programme.
  • Maintain a clear view of delivery, progress, risks and opportunities across the programme’s existing portfolio, and use evidence and judgement to guide decisions, unblock delivery and strengthen impact.
  • Build and convene a high-quality network across academia, AI and compute infrastructure, industry, government, funders and the wider technical ecosystem.
  • Develop trusted relationships with the institutions, funders and partners needed to support the Scaling Inference Lab’s growth and long-term sustainability.

How we'll support you

We will give you the support and autonomy to move quickly, including:
  • A world-class operating team to support programme delivery, partnerships, contracting, funding processes and operational problem-solving.
  • Close partnership with ARIA’s Chief Translation Officer, Executive team, Programme Operations

  • A strong track record of leading complex R&D programmes, projects or portfolios, with sound judgement on technical and delivery risk.
